htmlLang.note: The template writes it, not the framework.

title.how: The starter's layout writes a fixed <title>; a title per page is written by hand.

description.how: A <meta name="description"> written in the layout's head.

contentInHtml.how: Components render to HTML at build time; no client JS unless a client:* directive asks.

openGraph.how: og:* tags written by hand in the layout's head.

csp.how: security.csp: true in astro.config hashes Astro's scripts and styles into a policy meta tag.
csp.note: Stable since Astro 6; a meta tag, not active in astro dev.

frameOptions.how: A header set at the host or in middleware; a meta-tag policy cannot carry frame-ancestors.

robots.how: A file in public/, or a generic endpoint that writes one.

sitemap.how: The official @astrojs/sitemap integration, with site set.

canonical.how: A <link rel="canonical"> written by hand from Astro.url and site.

jsonLd.how: A <script type="application/ld+json"> written by hand with set:html.
